newsitem.title: CHINA: China April CPI up 3.2 pct yr/yr - State Statistics.
newsitem.headline: China April CPI up 3.2 pct yr/yr - State Statistics.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation rose a year-on-year 3.2 percent in April while the rate for January-April was 4.7 percent year-on-year, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
Consumer price inflation in March was 4.0 percent year-on-year in March.
China would continue tight control in coming months over new development projects to try to contain inflationary pressure, the bureau said.
Retail price inflation rose by 1.1 percent year-on-year in April, and increased 2.3 percent for the first four months compared with the year-ago period, official figures showed.
China has set a target of 6.0 percent for its benchmark retail price inflation for 1997 compared with 6.1 percent last year but officials expect the rate for the year to be as low as 3.0-4.0 percent.
